To the girl who has been a beautiful part of my life, my partner in arguments, my secret keeper, my supporter and forever my sister. 🥰

A Little Letter For You 💌

Something I don't always say out loud...

Dear Nithisha,

Life gives us many relationships, but the bond between a brother and sister is something truly special. We may fight over the smallest things, tease each other, annoy each other and sometimes even refuse to talk... but at the end of the day, you will always be my sister.

I may not say it every day, but I am genuinely grateful that I have you in my life.

No matter where life takes us, how much we grow, or how many years pass by, I will always be there to protect you, support you and stand beside you.

You are not just my sister. You are one of the people who makes my life a little more beautiful. ❤️

Happy Raksha Bandhan, Nithisha! Keep smiling, keep shining and always stay the wonderful person you are. 🌸

— Your Brother ❤️
